title: Steering lock and suspension response
inputs: Use a level marked surface and document tire, wheel, mass and alignment state
Capture straight-ahead and full-left/full-right wheel angles
Capture static ride height plus controlled compression and rebound timing
expected: Steering input-to-wheel relationship or bounded ratio
Suspension travel, static deflection and response band
toleranceNotes: At least five repetitions. Declare angle-reading uncertainty and marker-placement error; do not infer spring/damper constants from visual travel alone.
